KOD.headline: KOD Stock Soars 178% on Positive Wet AMD Data as BLA Filing Nears
KOD.description: Kodiak Sciences announced positive Phase III DAYBREAK study results for Zenkuda (tarcocimab tedromer), showing non-inferiority to Regeneron's Eylea in treating wet age-related macular degeneration. The drug demonstrated sustained retinal drying with 54% of patients reaching a six-month dosing interval, superior safety profile, and strong durability. Kodiak plans a multi-indication BLA submission in Q4 2026. The stock surged 178% on the announcement.

IOVA.headline: IOVA Stock Hits 52-Week High on Raised Revenue Outlook for 2026
IOVA.description: Iovance Biotherapeutics raised its 2026 revenue outlook to $410-$420 million from $350-$370 million, driven by strong patient demand for its therapies Amtagvi and Proleukin. The stock surged 31.5% following the announcement. Amtagvi, the first FDA-approved TIL therapy for melanoma, generated $151 million in sales in H1 2026 with 54% year-over-year growth, and the company plans to expand authorized treatment centers from 100 to at least 110 by year-end.

IOVA.headline: Iovance Biotherapeutics (IOVA) Surges 31.5%: Is This an Indication of Further Gains?
IOVA.description: Iovance Biotherapeutics shares surged 31.5% to $14.45 after the company raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $410-$420 million from $350-$370 million. The stock is expected to report quarterly revenues of $106.85 million (up 58.4% year-over-year) with a loss of $0.12 per share. However, analysts note that without recent earnings estimate revisions, the stock's momentum may not sustain, and the company carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.
